title: Bose’s Stylish Ultra Open Earbuds Are 33 Percent Off Right Now
gist: A deals post: Bose's original Ultra Open Earbuds are discounted from $299 to $199 (33% off) on Amazon, matching their lowest price, because Bose launches the Sport Open Earbuds and Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen) on October 1. The piece credits Bose with popularizing the clip-on open-earbud form factor since its 2024 launch.

insights.claim: Bose is expanding its clip-on open-earbud line with two new products, the Bose Sport Open Earbuds and the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds (2nd Gen), both launching October 1, 2026.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Signals Bose is doubling down on open-ear audio as a product category; watch the new models' pricing and reception heading into the holiday season.
insights.locator: Bose is expanding its clip-on open earbud offerings

insights.claim: The original Bose Ultra Open Earbuds are marked down from $299 to $199 (33% off) at Amazon, matching their lowest observed price, while Bose and Best Buy still list them at $299; the discount is a clearance ahead of the successor launch.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Discounting of outgoing premium models at Amazon ahead of a refresh points to inventory clearing and possible pressure on consumer-audio margins.
insights.quote: Hence, the original Ultra Open Earbuds are on sale, matching the lowest price I've seen for them.
insights.locator: Bose is expanding its clip-on open earbud offerings

insights.claim: Bose's Ultra Open Earbuds, launched in 2024, are credited with popularizing the clip-on open-earbud form factor, which wraps around the outside of the ear like an earring, even though Shokz had sold bone-conduction and open-ear headphones for years before.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Shows a major brand entering a niche that incumbents like Shokz built and scaling it through fashion-led design; a common pattern in consumer-hardware category expansion.
insights.quote: this small, fashionable form factor really took off
insights.locator: I would argue that Bose helped popularize

insights.claim: Open earbuds like the Bose Ultra Open have no noise canceling of any kind; they are positioned for situational awareness during activities such as running, cycling, or household chores.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Open-ear is a use-case-driven segment (fitness, awareness) alongside noise-canceling buds rather than a replacement for them; Bose's separate 'Sport' model fits that split.
insights.locator: The Bose Ultra Open Earbuds are premium open earbuds

insights.claim: WIRED's reviewer rates the Bose Ultra Open Earbuds as the best premium open earbuds, citing better controls, sound, and comfort than competitors, with high price as their main drawback.
insights.speaker: Harry Rabinowitz
insights.so_what: Bose leads on product quality in premium open-ear, but price is the main weak point, which leaves room for cheaper rivals.
insights.quote: their big con, price, is much more palatable at 33 percent off
